items.title: Pfizer Signs $1.5 Billion Deal With Blackstone to Fund Weight-Loss-Drug Development
items.summary: The investment is set to cover development costs for berobenatide, an investigational drug being studied for chronic weight management and obesity-related conditions.

items.title: Blackstone Aims to Raise $3 Billion for Real Estate Secondaries
items.summary: Blackstone Inc. is pitching a fund that will snap up stakes in other asset managers’ real estate vehicles, expecting to raise at least $3 billion amid a prolonged need for liquidity in the sector.

items.title: IIFL: Can Sustain 25-30% Lending Growth For 3-4 Years
items.summary: IIFL Finance Founder & MD Nirmal Jain believes his company can sustain 25 percent to 30 percent lending growth for three to four years. IIFL Finance offers gold, home and business loans, as well as financing against property and to small and medium-sized enterprises. He speaks with Haslinda Amin on "Insight with Haslinda Amin."
